correctness.rationale: The vertex-induced forest complex on KG(5,2), not its edge-set graphic-matroid complex, has 786 faces including empty, f-vector (10,45,120,210,240,140,20), and 22 minimal nonfaces (12 five-cycles, 10 six-cycles). Independent complete 1024-mask enumeration reconstructed all faces. Pivot matching on the face poset yields 389 matched nonempty face pairs with a directed Hasse graph acyclic on 785 nonempty faces; its only critical cells are one 0-cell and six 5-cells, so integral homotopy is wedge^6 S^5. Independent exhaustive 120 group elements signed simplicial Lefschetz character equals (6,0,-2,0,0,0,1) by S5 cycle type, identical to wedge² of the standard four-dimensional rational module, irreducible S^(3,1,1). Direct matching and character computations corroborated source; finite proof is exhaustive because exactly 2^10 subsets and 120 permutations were checked.
